title: Towards Bridging the Digital Language Divide

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the standard deviation of performance metrics across multiple languages. The paper evaluates this by measuring the coverage of cross-lingual mappings in lexical databases, comparing the perplexity of language models across artificial languages with varying word orders, and computing the average semantic distance of machine translation outputs across diverse languages.
Qualitative observation and evaluation of machine translation systems defaulting to male terms when translating gender-specific concepts through a gender-neutral pivot language (like English).
